dhp306:1: The one who speaks falsely goes to the underworld,
dhp306:2: and he who says: ‘I did not do’ what he has done,
dhp306:3: both of these are just the same when they have gone
dhp306:4: to the hereafter, (they are) humans who did base deeds.
dhp307:1: Many wearing the monastic robe around their necks are wicked, unrestrained,
dhp307:3: the wicked through their wicked deeds re-arisein the underworld.
dhp308:1: It’s better to have eaten a glowing iron ball,
dhp308:3: than that (the monastic) who is unrestrained and unvirtuous should enjoy the country’s almsfood.
dhp309:1: There are four states the man who is heedless,
dhp309:2: the man who consorts with other man’s wives, undergoes:
dhp309:3: he gains demerit, an uncomfortable bed,
dhp309:4: blame as third, and (rebirth in) the underworld as fourth.
dhp310:1: Gaining demerit and a bad destiny,
dhp310:2: and (only) the small delight of a scared man with a scared woman,
dhp310:3: and kings who apply heavy punishment,
dhp310:4: a man therefore should not consort with another’s wife.
dhp311:1: As jagged grass, wrongly grasped, cuts into the hand,
dhp311:3: so does the ascetic life, wrongly grasped, drag one down to the underworld.
dhp312:1: Whatever lax deed there is and that vow which is defiled,
dhp312:3: (know that) a holy life that is doubtful does not have great fruit for that one.
dhp313:1: If he would do what should be done,
dhp313:2: he should be firm in his effort,
dhp313:3: for the wanderer who is lax spreads a lot of impurity.
dhp314:3: better done is what is well-done, which, when done, one does not regret.
dhp315:1: As a border town is guarded on the inside and the outside,
dhp315:3: so one should watch over oneself,
dhp315:4: and you should not let the moment pass,
dhp315:5: for when the chance has passed they grieve when consigned to the underworld.
dhp316:1: They are ashamed of what is not shameful,
dhp316:2: not ashamed of what is shameful,
dhp316:3: undertaking wrong views, beings go to a bad destiny.
dhp317:1: Seeing fear in what is not fearful,
dhp317:2: not seeing fear in what is fearful,
dhp317:3: undertaking wrong views, beings go to a bad destiny.
dhp318:1: Finding blame in what is blameless,
dhp318:2: not seeing blame in what is blameable,
dhp318:3: undertaking wrong views, beings go to a bad destiny.
dhp319:1: Knowing blame in what is blameable,
dhp319:2: and no blame in what is blameless,
dhp319:3: undertaking right views, beings go to a good destiny.
dhp319:5: The Chapter about the Underworld, the Twenty-Second
